summary:
Fortinet 上一季 EPS 超預期5.7%，營收1.91億美元，安全需求穩健。
• EPS 0.68 美元，較預估0.64超出5.66%。
• 營收1.91億美元（B級），規模穩固。
• 資安支出剛性需求支撐基本盤。
• 本益比57.64，反映成長股溢價。
ai_view:
訊號偏正面：EPS 穩定超預期，顯示 Fortinet 在資安需求剛性下的獲利韌性。本季營收年增率未揭露，但結合下一季20%成長，動能向上。短期股價靠資安主題與業績支撐，中期看訂閱服務占比提升與防火牆換機紅利。追蹤指標：billings、服務營收占比、SASE 進展與自由現金流。57.6倍本益比要求成長持續，估值容錯空間有限。

需留意：營收年增率未提供，成長趨勢需後續確認。；產品（硬體）營收循環性風險。；高估值放大任何指引下修的衝擊。

summary_en:
Fortinet beat EPS by 5.7% with $1.91B revenue, on steady security demand.
• EPS of $0.68 beat the $0.64 estimate by 5.66%.
• Revenue of $1.91B held a solid scale.
• Inelastic cybersecurity spending anchors the base.
• P/E of 57.64 reflects a growth-stock premium.

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: a steady EPS beat shows earnings resilience amid inelastic security demand. Revenue YoY was undisclosed, but with the following quarter's 20% growth, momentum points up. Near-term the stock leans on the security theme and earnings; mid-term watch a rising subscription-services mix and the firewall refresh dividend. Track billings, service-revenue mix, SASE progress, and free cash flow. A 57.6x P/E requires sustained growth with limited margin for error.

Watch：Revenue YoY was not provided, requiring later confirmation.; Product (hardware) revenue cyclicality poses risks.; A high valuation amplifies any guidance-cut impact.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 較預估高出5.66%，穩定優於市場共識。
